sections.html: Leporinus steyermarki is a beautiful large tetra. It can reach a maximum size of about 30 cm and originates from Venezuela.
Like all Leporinus, this fish is an omnivorous animal that takes a lot of plant material for food.

In German, the fish is now and then named "Grey Leporinus", which is for sure not describing accurately the coloration of the animal. Maybe this name bases on a confusion with another of the numerous species of Leporinus.

Lexicon: Leporinus: Latin, means "hare-nose". steyermarki: named for Julian A. Steyermark who led the 1953 botanical Venezuela Expedition of the Chicago Natural History Museum; the fish was discovered during this expedition.

Suggestion of a common name: Golden Spotted Leporinus
